name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: A time of day, typed ("930", "9:30 pm", "21:30") or picked from the day's times at a minute step, in the locale's 12- or 24-hour clock — the same field chrome, sizes and states as every input.

meta.whenToUse: A time of day on its own (an opening hour, a reminder time), or the time half of a date and time (DateTimePicker). size="sm" + variant="ghost" is the inline row tier.
meta.whenNotToUse: A date and a time together (DateTimePicker), a duration (NumberField with a unit), or a time range.
